finalText:
Went through all 700 tests (test_0 through test_699). Here's the rundown:

**698 passed, 2 failed.**

Both failures are in `auth/tokens.test.js`:
1. **`refreshToken silently accepts an already-revoked token`** — auth/tokens.test.js:400
2. **`sessionCleanup leaves orphaned rows after a rollback`** — auth/tokens.test.js:650

Both are in the token/session-handling area, so worth a look together — one's a revocation check that isn't being enforced, the other's a cleanup routine not rolling back cleanly. Everything else in the suite passed clean.
